notes: CCTV Watch event definitions. Observations are what a camera can directly show; causes are explanations that need support. Adding a type means adding an entry here. Screening and confirmation thresholds live in cctv_watch_thresholds.json. persistence says how fast a condition can genuinely change: lasting (the default for still evidence) cannot vanish within a couple of minutes, so a better look at the same moment that finds nothing rules the sighting out; transient (the default for motion and clip evidence) can, so contrary evidence only ends it. A report's agrees list names the observations an official report of that kind describes.

screening.notes: Each type's screening score is how much more a frame looks like that type's phrases than like the closest of these ordinary scenes (BK's gate review, 2026-10-07). Phrases describe what is visible, never an interpretation such as a crash.
neutral: an ordinary road with normal traffic
a highway at night with car headlights and tail lights
a city intersection on a normal day
a foggy or hazy sky above a road
a road with wet pavement after rain

smoke.label: Smoke
phrases: a column of smoke rising from a fire
thick grey smoke billowing from a fire
a wildfire smoke plume over hills
smoke.describe: Smoke from a fire. Not fog, haze, dust, steam or vehicle exhaust.

flames.label: Flames
phrases: bright orange flames of a fire
a building burning with flames
a brush fire with visible flames

vehicle_fire.label: Vehicle fire
phrases: a car on fire
a burning vehicle with flames and black smoke
a truck engulfed in flames
vehicle_fire.describe: A vehicle that is on fire.

water_on_road.label: Water across the road
phrases: a flooded street with cars in deep water
flood water covering a road
a car driving through deep flood water
water_on_road.describe: Standing or flowing water covering part of the roadway. Not just a wet surface or puddles at the edge.

snow_ice_on_road.label: Snow or ice on the road
phrases: a road covered in snow
a snowy highway with snow on the lanes
snow_ice_on_road.describe: Snow or ice covering the road surface in the traffic lanes.

whiteout.label: Whiteout
phrases: a whiteout blizzard with blowing snow
heavy snowfall hiding everything
whiteout.describe: Falling or blowing snow so heavy that most of the scene is white.

low_visibility.label: Low visibility
phrases: dense fog hiding a road
a road disappearing into thick fog
low_visibility.describe: The scene itself is hard to see because of fog, heavy rain, smoke or dust in the air. Not a problem with the camera lens.

debris_on_road.label: Debris on the road
phrases: boulders lying on a road
a fallen tree blocking a road
debris scattered across a road
debris_on_road.describe: Debris, rocks, a fallen tree or other objects lying in the traffic lanes.

overturned_vehicle.label: Overturned vehicle
phrases: an overturned car lying on its roof
a truck tipped over on its side
overturned_vehicle.describe: A vehicle lying on its side or roof.

damaged_vehicles.label: Damaged vehicles
phrases: cars with crumpled, damaged bodies
two cars smashed into each other
a wrecked car
damaged_vehicles.describe: Vehicles with visible crash damage, or vehicles touching each other the way they do after a collision.

vehicle_off_road.label: Vehicle off the road
phrases: a car sitting in a ditch beside the road
a car that left the road and is stuck in the grass
vehicle_off_road.describe: A vehicle off the paved road in a ditch, median or embankment. Not a vehicle in a parking area or on a shoulder.

work_zone.label: Work zone
phrases: a highway work zone with orange drums and cones
road construction with workers and equipment
work_zone.describe: Road work: orange drums, cones, barriers, arrow boards, construction equipment or workers in vests. Not a crash and not an emergency response.

vehicle_stopped_on_shoulder.label: Vehicle stopped on the shoulder
phrases: a car stopped on the shoulder of a highway
a vehicle pulled over at the side of the road
vehicle_stopped_on_shoulder.describe: A vehicle standing still on the paved shoulder beside the traffic lanes, with no other vehicles queued behind it.

vehicle_stopped_in_lane.label: Vehicle stopped in a lane
phrases: a vehicle stopped across a traffic lane
a car stopped in the middle of the road while traffic goes around it
vehicle_stopped_in_lane.describe: A single vehicle standing still in a traffic lane while other traffic moves around it. Not vehicles queued in stopped traffic or waiting at a signal.

emergency_response.label: Emergency response on scene
phrases: police cars and a fire truck with flashing lights stopped on a road
an ambulance and firefighters standing on a road
emergency_response.describe: Police, fire or ambulance vehicles stopped at a scene, or flares and cones set out by responders.

structural_damage.label: Structural damage
phrases: a collapsed building
a destroyed building after a disaster
structural_damage.describe: A collapsed or visibly damaged building, bridge, sign structure or wall.

people_on_roadway.label: People on the roadway
phrases: people walking in the lanes of a highway
people_on_roadway.describe: People on foot in traffic lanes. Not on sidewalks, crosswalks or shoulders.

crowd.label: Crowd
phrases: a large crowd of people
a dense crowd filling a street
crowd.describe: People gathered together. Give an approximate count and the density: sparse, moderate, dense or packed.

stage_tents_barriers.label: Stage, tents or barriers
phrases: a street festival with tents and booths
crowd control barriers along a street
stage_tents_barriers.describe: Event infrastructure: a stage, tents, booths or crowd barriers.

traffic_stopped.label: Traffic stopped
phrases: a traffic jam with cars at a standstill
a long line of stopped cars
traffic_stopped.describe: Vehicles in the traffic lanes do not move between the frames.

traffic_slow.label: Traffic slow
traffic_slow.describe: Vehicles move between the frames, but slowly and closely spaced.

traffic_flowing.label: Traffic flowing
traffic_flowing.describe: Vehicles move normally between the frames.

road_clear.label: Road clear
road_clear.describe: The traffic lanes in view are clear of debris, wrecked or stopped vehicles, and responders.

people_running.label: People running or scattering
phrases: several people running across a street
a crowd scattering
people_running.describe: Several people running or scattering across the frames.

physical_altercation.label: Physical altercation
phrases: people fighting
a person punching another person
physical_altercation.describe: People hitting, grappling with or attacking each other across the frames.

smoke.question: What is the hazy, grey or dark area in the close-up?
smoke.sequenceNote: Smoke drifts and changes shape between frames; a mark on the lens stays at exactly the same place in every frame.
smoke.sceneQuestion: What is the hazy, grey or dark patch in the area in question?

flames.question: Is there fire with visible flames in the close-up, or something bright that is not fire?
flames.sceneQuestion: Is there fire with visible flames in the area in question, or something bright that is not fire?

vehicle_fire.question: Is the vehicle in the close-up on fire? Tail lights, brake lights, hazard lights and emergency lights are not fire.
vehicle_fire.sceneQuestion: Is the vehicle in the area in question on fire? Tail lights, brake lights, hazard lights and emergency lights are not fire.

overturned_vehicle.question: How is the vehicle in the close-up lying: on its side, on its roof, or upright on its wheels?
overturned_vehicle.sceneQuestion: How is the vehicle in the area in question lying: on its side, on its roof, or upright on its wheels?

damaged_vehicles.question: Do the vehicles in the close-up show crash damage (crumpled or torn body, broken parts, pieces on the road), or are two vehicles touching each other?
damaged_vehicles.sceneQuestion: Do the vehicles in the area in question show crash damage (crumpled or torn body, broken parts, pieces on the road), or are two vehicles touching each other?

vehicle_off_road.question: Where is the vehicle in the close-up?
vehicle_off_road.sceneQuestion: Where is the vehicle in the area in question?

vehicle_stopped_on_shoulder.question: Where is the vehicle in the close-up, and does it stay in the same place in every frame?

vehicle_stopped_in_lane.question: Is the vehicle in the close-up standing still in a traffic lane while other traffic moves past it?

emergency_response.question: What vehicles or equipment are in the close-up?
emergency_response.sceneQuestion: What vehicles or equipment are in the area in question?

people_on_roadway.question: Where are the people in the close-up, whether standing, walking, kneeling or lying on the ground?
people_on_roadway.sceneQuestion: Where are the people in the area in question, whether standing, walking, kneeling or lying on the ground?

debris_on_road.question: Are there objects lying in the traffic lanes in the close-up?
debris_on_road.sceneQuestion: Are there objects lying in the traffic lanes in the area in question?

water_on_road.question: Is water covering part of the traffic lanes in the close-up?
water_on_road.sceneQuestion: Is water covering part of the traffic lanes in the area in question?

snow_ice_on_road.question: Is snow or ice covering the traffic lanes in the close-up?
snow_ice_on_road.sceneQuestion: Is snow or ice covering the traffic lanes in the area in question?

whiteout.question: Is falling or blowing snow hiding most of the scene?
whiteout.sceneQuestion: Is falling or blowing snow hiding most of the scene?

low_visibility.question: What makes the scene hard to see?
low_visibility.sceneQuestion: What makes the scene hard to see?

structural_damage.question: Is the building, bridge or structure in the close-up collapsed or visibly damaged?
structural_damage.sceneQuestion: Is the building, bridge or structure in the area in question collapsed or visibly damaged?

crowd.question: How many people are gathered together in the close-up?
crowd.sceneQuestion: How many people are gathered together in the area in question?

stage_tents_barriers.question: What is set up in the close-up?
stage_tents_barriers.sceneQuestion: What is set up in the area in question?

traffic_stopped.question: Across the frames, do the vehicles in the traffic lanes move?

people_running.question: Across the frames, are several people running or scattering?

physical_altercation.question: Across the frames, are people hitting, grappling with or attacking each other?
